clips.title: 74%不是钱够用：是活到90岁，你的退休数字算对了吗？
title_lines: 你的退休数字算对了吗？

subtitles.en: Michael Conrath is an adult in the Roman retirement, which J.P. Morgan has an management.
subtitles.zh: 迈克尔·康拉斯是摩根大通资管的一位资深人士。

subtitles.en: And he usually shows up with a PowerPoint. And I got a chart I made.
subtitles.zh: 他通常带着PPT来。我做了个图表。

subtitles.en: Of course, his chart's better, but what's important, page 60 pages in page four is the money chart.
subtitles.zh: 当然，他的图表更好，但重要的是，60页中的第4页是资金图表。

subtitles.en: This is the one that matters. Luigi, bring up the chart here. Have the interns bring up the chart, Luigi.
subtitles.zh: 这才是关键。路易吉，把图表调出来。让实习生把图表调出来，路易吉。

subtitles.en: I know you're voting right now. And I'm sorry, this is life expectancy.
subtitles.zh: 我知道你们现在在投票。抱歉，这是预期寿命。

subtitles.en: This is the heart of the matter. This is what's changed for fossils like me and even for the young tourists.
subtitles.zh: 这是问题的核心。这对像我这样的老家伙，甚至对年轻游客来说，都发生了变化。

subtitles.en: Michael Conrath with us. This is the unmovable force is that 90 is the new 65.
subtitles.zh: 迈克尔·康拉斯与我们同在。不可动摇的力量是，90岁是新的65岁。

subtitles.en: Yeah, it certainly is Tom. And it's great to be with you both here the day before Halloween.
subtitles.zh: 是的，确实是，汤姆。很高兴在万圣节前一天和你们两位在一起。

subtitles.en: And this is a scary figure to a lot of people because one of the big questions people have is how long does my money need to last?
subtitles.zh: 对很多人来说，这是一个可怕的数据，因为人们的一大问题是：我的钱需要维持多久？

subtitles.en: And the short answer is it needs to last as long as you do, but as you pointed out with that chart, Tom, there is a 74% chance.
subtitles.zh: 简短的回答是，它需要和你活得一样久，但正如你用那张图表指出的，汤姆，有74%的可能性。

subtitles.en: One member of a 65 year old couple today lives to age 90 or beyond, 44% chance.
subtitles.zh: 如今一对65岁夫妇中，有一人活到90岁或以上，概率为44%。

subtitles.en: One of them lives to 95. Cut to the chase, yeah. You're in a bar with Gabrielle Santos.
subtitles.zh: 其中一人活到95岁。直说吧，你在酒吧和加布里埃尔·桑托斯聊天。

subtitles.en: Not that that would ever happen, but cut to the chase. The kids think they need to have X amount of 100,000s or a million or whatever to get out to 90.
subtitles.zh: 虽然这不太可能发生，但直说吧。孩子们认为他们需要几十万或一百万之类的钱才能活到90岁。

subtitles.en: What's the real number we need today to think about given this longevity?
subtitles.zh: 考虑到这种长寿趋势，我们今天真正需要考虑的数字是多少？

terms.sense: the total amount a person needs saved to retire
expected lifespan / probability of reaching a given age

terms.context: J.P. Morgan annual retirement research report

clip_research.source_claim: People don't know their retirement number, and there is a 74% chance (per the life expectancy chart) relevant to how long money must last.
clip_research.public_baseline: J.P. Morgan's Guide to Retirement states a 65-year-old couple has a 74% chance that at least one partner reaches age 90.
clip_research.surprise_gap: The 74% figure is a longevity probability, not a probability that savings will last; the title's framing of 'half of people don't know their number' is a separate survey-style claim not directly confirmed by the snippets.

evidence.fact: Conrath says people don't know how long their money needs to last and cites a 74% figure tied to a life expectancy chart.

evidence.query: J.P. Morgan 74% chance retirement money last life expectancy
evidence.fact: J.P. Morgan Guide to Retirement: 65-year-old couple has 74% chance at least one reaches 90.
Conrath is Chief Retirement Strategist at J.P. Morgan Asset Management.

forbidden_claims: Claiming the 74% is the probability that retirement money will last
Claiming exactly half of Americans were surveyed and don't know their number without a source
Claiming Conrath criticized J.P. Morgan's own products

notes: The current Chinese title '摩根大通高管：半数人不知退休目标数字' uses a generic '高管'; the verified title is 首席退休策略师.
The '74%' in the transcript refers to life expectancy probability, not savings adequacy; editors should avoid conflating the two.

data_driven_lessons.source: KC桌面-视频号动态数据明细.csv, 114 rows, July 2026 local analysis
winning_patterns: 机构/人物权威 + 具体数字/资产 + 强问题，例如 高盛王逸：4-5万亿城市更新会拖住楼市吗
大机构/名人 + 被逼/陷阱/真相/转向 等张力词，例如 野村辜朝明：日本央行被逼到墙角
具体数据 + 政策动作疑问，例如 6月PMI释放积极信号，政府会加码吗
反常识判断 + 下一步条件，例如 低估值可能是价值陷阱，需等待政策转向消费
中国相关议题更容易获得点击，但表达要落在政策、需求、信心、估值、产业升级这些正向框架
外资或海外权威给出对中国更积极的判断时，反差本身就是主标题，不要埋在摘要里
让观众产生单一强反应：居然如此、终于有人说、他说的是真的吗、原来中国优势在这里
大实话角度来自表达者身份与观点反差；言行反差角度必须有公开动作或披露支撑
涉及中国比较优势时，优先把外国企业被迫调整、海外权威改口或中国优势被低估写成冲突
avoid_patterns: 过长的新闻句，尤其是 24 字以上还塞多个从句
只有 策略/机会/影响/前瞻/市场/风险 这类泛词，没有具体对象或张力
美国宏观泛标题如果没有美联储/鲍威尔等强锚点，点击明显弱
纯描述式标题，例如 某市场短期风险与长期催化剂，缺少问题和冲突
经济危机/金融危机/崩盘/崩溃 这类过硬负面财经词
把事实换成疑问号但没有反差，例如 回报路径在哪、未来如何、能否实现
陌生英文人名或机构全称占据第一行，却没有告诉观众这个人为什么值得听
把 Bloomberg LP 等来源或公司法律后缀误当成采访对象
没有公开证据却暗示嘉宾撒谎、操纵或言行不一
